journey.title: The full journey
journey.body: Payday, Ritm off. You do the onboarding live.

spike.title: Too fast
spike.body: Ritm on with the Speed bump. The Heads-up is waiting; the jacket pauses at checkout.

unlock.title: The Lock opens
unlock.body: Ritm on; the 500 lei unlock by themselves.

payday.title: Payday again
payday.body: Day 30, the 500 lei kept saved. Ready for the summary.

payments.title: Payments
payments.intro: Pay online or by card in store. In this demo, payments are simulated.
payments.simulatedNote: In-store payments can’t be paused. You get a message right away with what you have left.
payments.tapToast: You just spent {amount} at {merchant}. Safe to spend today: {safe}.

profile.title: Profile
profile.offBody: Once it’s on, it watches how fast your salary goes and tells you early. You choose how strict it is.
profile.statusHint: Watches the pace of your spending since payday.
profile.offPending: Ritm turns off on day {day}. Until then it stays on.
profile.offConfirmBody: It turns off in 24 hours, on day {day}. Until then everything stays as it is.
profile.offConfirmLock: The money in the Lock ({amount}) stays there until day {day}.
profile.thresholdHint: At the Speed bump and Lock levels, online payments of {amount} or more get a short pause. In-store payments are never stopped.
profile.essentialsHint: What’s on here doesn’t count towards your pace: it’s taken out of your spending money first.

accounts.savingsEmpty: Your savings account is empty for now. If you turn on Lock in Ritm, the money you set aside lands here.

detail.notFound: We couldn’t find this transaction. It may have been cleared when the demo was reset.

ritm.notCountedTitle: Doesn’t count towards this month’s pace
ritm.counted: It comes out of your spending money until payday.
ritm.moneyIn: This is money coming in, not spending.
ritm.planned: You marked it as planned, so it doesn’t change your pace.
ritm.essential: It’s an essential cost, already taken out of your spending money.
ritm.notCounted: The money stays yours, between your own accounts or set aside.

confirm.title: Confirm payment
confirm.intro: An online shop is asking for this payment.

speedBump.title: A short pause
speedBump.body: You’re about to pay {amount} to {merchant}. Safe to spend today: {safe}. The choice is yours.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.empty: No notifications yet. When your salary arrives or Ritm has something to tell you, it shows up here.

ritmInvite.title: Want your salary to last until the next one?
ritmInvite.bodyPayday: Your salary just came in. Ritm watches how fast you spend from today on and tells you early, not after the money is gone. You choose how strict it is.
ritmInvite.body: Ritm watches how fast you spend your salary and tells you early, not after the money is gone. You choose how strict it is.
ritmInvite.note: 3 steps. No money moves without your OK.

askRitm.title: Ask Ritm
askRitm.intro: I can explain the pause, the numbers on your screen and your options. I won’t tell you what to buy: the choice stays yours.
askRitm.error: I couldn’t answer right now. Check your connection and try again.
askRitm.disclaimer: Ritm explains; it doesn’t decide for you.

pace.aria: You've used {spent}% of your spending money and {month}% of the month has passed. {status}

line.ok: At this rate you'll reach payday comfortably.
line.watch: You're spending a little faster than the month is passing.
line.spike: Money is going faster than the days. Go easy today.

headsup.name: Heads-up
headsup.description: Tells you when you spend faster than the month passes. Nothing is blocked.

speedbump.name: Speed bump
speedbump.description: Before a big online payment, shows you the numbers and lets you confirm after 5 seconds.

lock.name: Lock
lock.description: Puts an amount aside on payday and unlocks it on the day you choose.

playground.title: Ritm · components
playground.pickDay: Pick a day of the month

s1.title: Your first salary is here
s1.l1: Ritm watches how fast your money goes since payday.
s1.l2: It tells you early if you're going too fast, not after the money is gone.
s1.l3: You choose how strict it is. You can turn it off anytime.

s2.title: The payments you have to make anyway
s2.intro: We found these in your statement. Ritm leaves them out when it watches your pace.
s2.plannedHint: Already know you'll buy something this month? Add it here and it won't trigger any heads-up.
s2.plannedInvalid: Write what you're buying and how much it costs.

s3.title: Choose how Ritm helps you
s3.lockTitle: Put some of your salary aside
s3.lockExplain: On payday we move {amount} to savings. It unlocks by itself on day {day}; if you need it sooner, you get it 24 hours after asking.
s3.lockNone: You're not putting anything aside this month. You can change this anytime.
s3.goalInvalid: Write a name and an amount for your goal.
s3.poolHint: Your salary, minus fixed payments and the amount put aside.

card.title: Ritm
card.headsUpCta: See why Ritm gave you a heads-up
card.lockOpen: The Lock is open: {amount} is free.

reason.pctSpent: Day {day}: you've already used {pct}% of your spending money.
reason.runOut: At this pace, the money runs out on day {day}, {daysBefore} days before payday.
reason.burst: {pct}% of your spending money went in the last 2 days.

title.watch: You're spending a little faster than the month is passing
title.spike: Money is going faster than the days

headsUp.intro: You can do something now, with one tap. Or nothing, it's your call.

actions.enableSpeedBump: Turn on Speed bump until payday

hint.moveToLock: The money stays aside and unlocks by itself on day {day}.
hint.enableSpeedBump: Before big online payments we show you the numbers and you confirm after 5 seconds.
hint.markPlanned: It stops counting towards your pace.

done.moveToLock: Done. {amount} moved to the Lock until day {day}.
done.enableSpeedBump: Done. Speed bump is on until payday.
done.markPlanned: Done. {merchant} no longer counts towards your pace.

speedBump.title: Quick check before you buy
speedBump.progress: Day {day} of {total}: you've used {pct}% of your spending money.
speedBump.goal: This amount is {days} days of saving for {goal}.
speedBump.choice: It's your choice. You can still pay.
speedBump.moveToLockHint: Instead of spending it now, it stays aside until day {day}.
speedBump.pensionHint: We explain how it works first, then you decide.
speedBump.lockedDone: Done. {amount} stays in the Lock until day {day}.

lock.title: Your Lock
lock.unlockOn: Opens by itself on day {day}. {days} days to go.
lock.unlockTomorrow: Opens by itself tomorrow, on day {day}.
lock.interestNote: Estimate: {rate}% a year on savings, after 10% tax. In the demo, interest is simulated.
lock.waysOut: If you need the money sooner
lock.earlyHint: You get all the money after 24 hours.
lock.earlyExplain: You ask now, and {amount} leaves the Lock tomorrow, on day {day}. That money stops being set aside for {goal}.
lock.requested: Unlock requested. {amount} leaves the Lock tomorrow, on day {day}.
lock.emergencyHint: The money arrives right away. Once a month.
lock.emergencyExplain: The money goes straight to your current account and the rest stays in the Lock. You can do this once a month.
lock.emergencyReason: What for? One word is enough.
lock.emergencyDone: Done. {amount} is in your current account.
lock.emergencyUsed: You've already used the emergency release this month. Unlocking with the 24-hour wait is still there.

error.overLimit: You can take out up to {max}.
error.reason: Write briefly what you need the money for.
error.alreadyUsed: You've already used the emergency release this month.
error.notLocked: There's nothing left in the Lock.

lock.unlocked: The Lock is open. {amount} is free.
lock.chooseCta: Choose what to do with it
lock.empty: Nothing in the Lock right now.

unlock.title: You made it to day {day} without it.
unlock.intro: {amount} is free. You choose how much stays aside.
unlock.keepLabel: How much you keep in savings
unlock.keepValue: You keep {keep}, and {back} goes to your current account.
unlock.confirmNone: Move it all to my current account
unlock.done: Done. {keep} stays in savings, {back} is in your current account.
unlock.notYet: The Lock opens on day {day}. Until then, the money stays aside.
unlock.compareIntro: Compared by how soon you can reach the money, risk and how long it stays. No promised returns.

flexibleSavings.name: Atlas flexible savings
flexibleSavings.tradeoff: Take the money out anytime, but the interest is low.
flexibleSavings.note: An Atlas product. This is where the money is now.

governmentBonds.name: Government bonds (Tezaur, Fidelis)
governmentBonds.tradeoff: The interest is fixed, but you get the money back only at maturity, after 1–5 years.
governmentBonds.note: Issued by the Romanian state, not Atlas.

pillar3.name: Pillar III (Atlas Pensii)
pillar3.tradeoff: You pay less tax now, but the money stays locked until retirement.
pillar3.note: Atlas Pensii is Atlas's own fund. You can compare funds on the ASF website.
